scope: Completion and limitation ledger for the supplied nine-sheet archive excerpt. It records what the visual review and authored modules establish, and what the absent remainder of the 191-sheet design set cannot establish.

source_limitations.finding: The supplied PDF contains nine mechanical sheets M-505 through M-512 and M-601 from an original 191-sheet project. This record is complete only for these nine supplied pages.

No mechanical floor/roof plan is supplied. Schedule rows, P&ID labels, templates, sensor roles and written sequences are not expanded into an installed equipment, sensor, actuator, controller, terminal, wire, or zone count.

The reviewed excerpt contains no separately printed control-valve schedule or damper-actuator schedule. P&ID/sequence valve and bypass references remain in their own source contexts rather than becoming schedule rows.

M-507 and M-508 provide P&IDs and point matrices but no written sequence-of-operations block; M-509 provides the written hydronic sequences and is not retroactively treated as printed on the adjacent P&ID sheets.
Repeated template matrix rows, source schedule-row marks, and P&ID local numeric tags are distinct units of evidence. They do not prove a physical quantity without missing plan/controller evidence.

visual_relationship_scope: Every supplied source page was rendered and visually reviewed. Visual review confirms page/table/diagram disposition and page-level absence limits; dual-engine text corroboration proves the bounded authored table cells and text assertions. Neither mechanism is described as an automatic engineering interpretation.
schedule_note_scope: All exact printed schedule cells, including notes fields and blank cells, are preserved in the M-505/M-601 source modules embedded by the schedules composite.
